description: Selectman Bob Snow, a U.S. Marine Corps veteran, received an appreciation medal from the state for his service on Monday night. “I was so proud to nominate Bob Snow for being a Marine … but [also] for being so much more than that — being an educator, a historian, and being involved in the town. Y
paid_for_by: Paid for by The Committee to Elect Kristin Kassner
title: Rowley Selectman Bob Snow Receives Military Appreciation Medal — Kristin Kassner for State Representative
